engine.name: Cocos Creator
engine.installation: NOT_VERIFIED; executable not found on PATH

rules.coordinates: integer x right, y down; origin top-left; 0<=x<width,0<=y<height
rules.arrow_shape: ordered distinct orthogonally adjacent cells, tail to head; last segment equals direction; singleton allowed
rules.movement: rigid translation of ALL occupied cells by heading vector; no snake-following, rotation or partial movement
rules.collision: union of in-bounds translated cells for k=1..max(width,height), against other remaining arrows, walls and CLOSED gates; own initial cells ignored
rules.exit_edge: direction alone determines edge; any coordinate on that edge is valid
rules.gate_semantics: initial_open XOR removed-arrow toggles; gates never rotate or move; open gates are passable and never occupy an initial arrow cell
rules.manifest_semantics: empty disables; otherwise one direction per arrow; next direction must match; no skip and no wildcard
rules.invalid_action: state unchanged; no hearts, time limit, currency or loss of attempt
rules.deadlock: remaining>0 AND no legal EXIT; undo/reset enabled; no ad rescue
rules.win: all arrows removed AND manifest cursor == manifest length
rules.undo: pop last accepted EXIT; recompute gates and manifest from original data and remaining log; no redo
rules.hint: lexicographically first arrow whose successor can reach win; no legal winning successor => show undo/reset
rules.rng: none in play; level seed is provenance only
rules.canonical_state_key: removed bitmask; gates and cursor derived

session_contract.rule_return: Accepted(nextAttempt, ruleFacts) or Reject; never publishes events
session_contract.event_id: boot-local sessionId + colon + strictly increasing positive sequence; allocated only by SessionCoordinator
session_contract.completion_owner: SessionCoordinator; firstClear computed from pre-action Progress.completed; stampCount from post-union completed set
session_contract.save_owner: SessionCoordinator emits one SaveRequested per accepted revision; SaveCoordinator only persists and returns result
session_contract.save_ack: SessionCoordinator publishes deduplicated SaveSucceeded/SaveFailed; acknowledgement never increments revision or triggers save
session_contract.undo_policy: Undo retains completed; completing again emits firstClear=false with unchanged stampCount; no REDO command exists
session_contract.interrupt_policy: Animation interruption never resubmits rule command or already queued snapshot; visibility flush deduplicates revision
session_contract.rejection_policy: Rejected action does not change revision/completed or request save

progression.unlock: L01 open; L(n+1) after first completion Ln; all completed replayable
progression.rewards: one first-clear stamp per level, replay gives none; stamp count derived from completed-level set
progression.ads: disabled in initial product; Full/P04 adapter ad capability reserved but not activated
progression.end: after L20 show all 20 stamps and replay/map buttons; no endless or daily mode

ui.pointer_commit: pointerup on same arrow after <=10 CSS px movement, pointercancel cancels; no hold timer
ui.keyboard: Tab focus by arrow ID then controls; Enter/Space activate; U undo; H hint; R opens reset confirmation; Escape pause/back

save.authoritative: accepted_exits replay; never trust stored gates/cursor
save.commit: temp JSON -> validate -> backup old -> main; recover newest valid revision; local commit after every EXIT/UNDO/RESET/WIN/settings
save.migration: v0 absent starts new; v1 strict validation; unknown newer version read-only recovery, never overwrite automatically
save.cloud: same channel only; union completed and choose newest valid active revision; equal revision conflict prompts user; no device fingerprint
save.private_mode: memory-only with visible notice; no blocking gameplay

channel_profiles.analytics: local opt-in bounded replay, no upload
platform-native outside bundle; no third-party SDK
Bridge only; no GA4 or equivalent
none until publisher-specific isolated contract approval

levels.name: 开港
levels.learning_objective: 点击整条箭头，清空棋盘

levels.name: 先疏后发
levels.learning_objective: 路径被另一箭条占用时先移除阻挡者

levels.name: 弯条也要净空
levels.learning_objective: 弯条整体平移，尾部的扫掠也算碰撞

levels.name: 交叉码头
levels.learning_objective: 两组依赖、可自由交换的独立操作

levels.name: 第一盏信号
levels.learning_objective: 带 g 印记箭条离港后翻转 g 门

levels.name: 开门之前
levels.learning_objective: 几何遮挡和门遮挡同时检查

levels.name: 双灯串联
levels.learning_objective: g 放行 b，b 再打开 h 给 a

levels.name: 不要连按开关
levels.learning_objective: 两次翻转关门；合法操作也可能造成残局死锁

levels.name: 两门交替
levels.learning_objective: 先用 g 通行，再交付 h；提前 d 会关 g

levels.name: 弯桥继电
levels.learning_objective: 弯条尾部、两组门和独立安全出口

levels.name: 船期单
levels.learning_objective: 必须按右、上、左出港

levels.name: 先清航线
levels.learning_objective: 船期和几何依赖一致，错误方向不会消耗步数

levels.name: 同向二选一
levels.learning_objective: 第一步两条朝上，先 a 会让下一条朝右无法离港

levels.name: 两次交接
levels.learning_objective: 同向选择后再处理另一组阻挡

levels.name: 曲线船期
levels.learning_objective: 弯条放行后按五项船期完成

levels.name: 灯号与船期
levels.learning_objective: 识别船期与门依次放行；唯一合法路线用于组合教学，不作为二选一规划题

levels.name: 同向不同信号
levels.learning_objective: 两条朝上只有 b 能打开下一班的门

levels.name: 双灯船队
levels.learning_objective: 两条朝右对象中初态仅c合法，辨认g阻挡a；不是两个合法候选的选择题

levels.name: 双信号分流
levels.learning_objective: 辨认提交后多门翻转；船期保护排除无船期的16个losing状态，不宣称组合必增策略

levels.name: 最后一班
levels.learning_objective: 两次同向选择与门闭合时机；计划七次离港
